name: llm-fleet
description: Every Claude Code session, background job and open pull request on this machine in one live pane, with alerts when one fails or waits for you.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: The interpreter the plugin's readers run under: a name on your PATH, such as python3, or a full path to one. Python 3.11 or newer.

configPath.title: Configuration file
configPath.description: The full path of your fleet configuration, when you keep it somewhere other than the default place (~/.config/llm-fleet/config.json). Leave empty to use the default. /llm-fleet setup writes a starter file there.

notify.title: Desktop notifications
notify.description: Raise a desktop notification when a job fails or waits for you. Off by default: a desktop notification puts itself in front of whatever you are working in, so it is asked for rather than given.
